en.headline: Autumn Home Expo opens at Convention Centre this Thursday
en.dek: More than 600 exhibitors covering furnishings, smart home and interior design will gather from 24 to 27 September, with a special display of state banquet porcelain used by the Chinese and Russian presidents.
body: The Autumn Home Expo 2026 will open at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre from Thursday to Sunday, organised by Exhibition Group and featuring more than 600 exhibitors across seven categories including building materials, interior design, smart home products, bedroom furnishings, health equipment, silver-age products and professional home services.

Organisers said the fair is timed for the wave of new-home completions in the second half of the year and aims to give owners a one-stop platform to compare designs, materials and prices. A special InZpireLUXE section will showcase high-end design furniture.

A highlight is the public display of the Spring Full Garden state-banquet porcelain series by manufacturer Starhigh. The set was used for a tea meeting between the Chinese and Russian presidents at the Great Hall of the People in May and was also selected for the Belt and Road Forum. It will be open to the public from 25 to 27 September only.
Opening hours are noon to 9 pm from 24 to 26 September and noon to 7 pm on 27 September. The fair is at Halls 3BCDE of the Convention Centre in Wan Chai.

zh.headline: 秋季家居博覽周四會展開鑼 展出中俄元首用瓷
zh.dek: 9月24至27日於會展舉行，逾600家展商涵蓋建材、智能家居及室內設計，另有國宴瓷系列公開展出。
body: 由展覽集團主辦的「秋季家居博覽2026」將於9月24至27日在香港會議展覽中心展覽廳3BCDE舉行，涵蓋建材設備、室內設計、智能家居、寢室用品、健康設備、樂齡產品及專業家居服務七大範疇，逾600間展商參展。
主辦單位表示，博覽適逢下半年新盤交樓潮，為準備入伙或翻新的業主提供一站式比較設計、物料及價格的平台。會場另設InZpireLUXE奢華設計傢具專區。
亮點之一是瓷具生產商「斯達高」公開展出《春滿園》國宴瓷系列。該套裝今年5月曾用作中俄元首在人民大會堂茶敘指定用品，亦獲選為一帶一路國際合作高峰論壇用瓷，只於9月25至27日開放予公眾參觀。
開放時間為9月24至26日中午12時至晚上9時，9月27日中午12時至晚上7時，地點為灣仔會展。
